column2: The game has 20 rounds. Tap Play sound and listen. Then the cards start moving along the curved ribbon toward the ear. Before each card goes into the ear, it stops and plays its own sound. When you hear the same sound you heard at the start, tap Stop – this is it! or say stop. If it is not the one, tap Continue or wait a moment and the ribbon moves on by itself. You can also tap a card directly or say its name. With Slower the ribbon moves slowly. At the end you will see how many you got right.
